intent_contract.text: 이번엔 노출도 있는 의상으로 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independently invented, random, visually complex photorealistic fashion-editorial test case that can later be rendered with the supplied image used only for visible appearance guidance, while making the requested visible-skin styling and concrete action clear enough for pixel-level keyword evaluation.

Create a photorealistic environmental fashion editorial at the terraced salt pans of Maras, Peru, immediately after a mountain sunshower. One unmistakably adult woman, using the supplied reference image only as visible appearance guidance, balances on a narrow ochre service ledge while pouring a copper bowl of brine into the next pool; the suspended stream arcs through the frame as wind drives sparkling droplets sideways. She wears an editorial ensemble that leaves deliberate areas of skin visible, while opaque fabric clearly covers her breasts and pelvis. Prioritize instantly readable adult age, outfit coverage, and the precise hand-to-bowl-to-water action. Also prioritize tactile salt crust, layered geometric ponds, wet stone reflections, distant Andean ridges, and believable skin, textile, metal, and water behavior. The scene feels physically plausible, richly detailed, and unmistakably photographed on location.
